findings.quote: The Parties intend to enter into discussions regarding a prospective strategic integration and commercial partnership (the Permitted Purpose). In connection with the Permitted Purpose, each Party may disclose to the other Party certain technical, proprietary, and commercial information. The Parties agree to protect such information on the terms of this Agreement.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB03 Purpose limitation (pass 0.99, breach 0.01, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 1.1.3 Confidential Information means all non-public information disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of a Disclosing Party to a Receiving Party in connection with the Permitted Purpose, whether orally, visually, in writing, or in electronic or other tangible form, including software architecture, APIs, source code, data pipelines, product roadmaps, customer pipelines, pricing methodologies, financial models, and business plans, which is marked confidential or should reasonably be understood to be confidential given its nature and context of disclosure.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB02 Definition of Confidential Information (pass 0.97, breach 0.02, unclear 0.01).
Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group (pass 0.63, breach 0.08, unclear 0.29).
Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB04 Carve-outs (pass 0.99, breach 0.01, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 3.2 Nothing in this Agreement shall restrict either Party or its Affiliates from using, disclosing, or commercialising any ideas, concepts, know-how, techniques, or information retained in the unaided memory of its personnel who have had authorised access to Confidential Information under this Agreement, provided that such personnel do not intentionally memorise such information for the purpose of reuse.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 3.2 and the words 'and Residuals' from the heading of Clause 3.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to agree a residuals clause as it would undermine the protection of each Party's confidential information. We have deleted it.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB17 Residuals (pass 0.00, breach 1.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 4.1 The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to the minimum extent required by mandatory statutory provision, court order, or binding rule of a competent regulatory or supervisory authority, provided that, to the extent legally permissible, the Receiving Party gives prompt written notice to the Disclosing Party to enable the Disclosing Party to seek an appropriate protective order.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 0.99, breach 0.01, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 5.1 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months following its termination or expiration, neither Party shall, directly or indirectly, whether as principal, agent, partner, or through any Affiliate, engage in the development, marketing, licensing, or commercial distribution of any cloud-based workflow automation or middleware software that competes directly with the core software product lines disclosed by the other Party during the Permitted Purpose discussions, nor shall either Party enter into any strategic integration or co-marketing venture with any named direct competitor of the other Party identified in writing during discussions.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are not able to accept restrictions on either Party's business activities in a confidentiality agreement. We have deleted Clause 5; the confidentiality obligations already protect the information each Party shares.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB16 Non-compete and exclusivity (pass 0.00, breach 1.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 6.1 Upon written request from the Disclosing Party following termination of discussions, the Receiving Party shall promptly destroy or return all tangible and electronic embodiments of Confidential Information, retaining only one copy strictly for legal compliance or dispute defence, and electronic records created through standard automated disaster recovery and data retention protocols.
findings.draft_redline: Within 10 Business Days of written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information and confirm this in writing, save that it may retain copies held in automated backups or required to be kept by law or regulation, which shall remain subject to this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We have set a clear 10 Business Day period for return or destruction and confirmed that backup and legally required copies may be kept, remaining confidential.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as unclear against PB07 Return and destruction (pass 0.26, breach 0.27, unclear 0.47).

findings.quote: 7.1 This Agreement takes effect on the date first written above and expires after two (2) years.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB12 Term and survival (pass 0.98, breach 0.01, unclear 0.01).

findings.quote: 7.2 The obligations set out in Clauses 2 and 3 shall survive expiration or termination of this Agreement for a period of three (3) years.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB12 Term and survival (pass 0.97, breach 0.01, unclear 0.02).

findings.quote: 8.1 Each Party acknowledges that any breach or threatened breach of this Agreement will cause irreparable injury, immediate harm, and grave commercial prejudice to the other Party for which monetary damages alone would be entirely inadequate. Accordingly, each Party stipulates and agrees that, upon any breach or imminent threat of breach, the non-defaulting Party shall be entitled, immediately and as a matter of right, to seek and obtain emergency injunctive relief, specific performance, and any other provisional remedies or decrees available in equity from any court of competent jurisdiction, without the necessity of proving actual damages, posting any bond, or providing other security, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB13 Remedies (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 9.1 No Licence. No licence, title, or interest under any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other intellectual property right is granted or implied by this Agreement.
findings.fallback_cited: Statement that each party owns its own IP and no licence is granted (any wording).
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB08 Ownership, licences and IP (pass 0.99, breach 0.00, unclear 0.01).

findings.quote: 9.2 Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the complete and exclusive statement of agreement between the Parties regarding confidentiality for the Permitted Purpose.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB21 Boilerplate (notices, variation, waiver, severance, third-party rights, entire agreement, counterparts) (pass 0.97, breach 0.02, unclear 0.01).

findings.quote: 9.3 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and delivered by electronic signature.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB21 Boilerplate (notices, variation, waiver, severance, third-party rights, entire agreement, counterparts) (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 9.4 Governing Law and Jurisdiction. This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. The courts of the district of Luxembourg City shall have exclusive jurisdiction to hear and determine any suit, action, or proceeding arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.
findings.draft_redline: This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to agree Luxembourg law and courts, and our standard is English law. If it assists, we could consider English law with non-exclusive jurisdiction.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB18 Governing law and jurisdiction (pass 0.00, breach 1.00, unclear 0.00).
